content.text: Intent
Let users record a free-text note against a customer name and see the saved notes in a list, newest first. It is deliberately minimal: one entity, saved and listed.
Scope
IN: one entity, CustomerNote (customer name, note text, created date), saved and listed.
OUT: everything else — links to a customer record, search beyond the platform's own, attachments, notifications.
Scenarios
None — keeping the bean's rows through its screen.
Requirements
R1: The system SHALL require a customer name and a note text on every CustomerNote.
R2: The system SHALL list saved notes newest first.
R3: The system SHALL present the notes list in the platform's standard table layout.
R4: WHEN a save is refused because the note text is missing, the system SHALL show a message that reads naturally.

Dependencies
None — no other spec or existing entity is relied on.
Constraints
Considered, none apply: authorization beyond the platform default, performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost.
Acceptance criteria
A1 (verifies R1): Saving a note without a customer name or without text is refused.
A2 (verifies R2): After saving two notes, the list shows the newer one first.
A3 (verifies R3) (manual): The notes list uses the platform's standard table layout.
A4 (verifies R4) (manual): The message for a note with no text reads naturally.
Migration & compatibility
None — new entity, nothing to migrate.
